authorization.scope: Extend fresh ACT training on the official AMD worker for the submission demo; public PR creation remains separately gated.

schedule.reason: A 60,000-step replay is estimated at 45.17 hours and cannot reliably finish before the submission deadline; 30,000 steps preserves a known checkpoint milestone while reserving time for demo and package gates.

required_entry_checks: training and evidence roots are absent
dataset metadata exactly matches this contract
torch.version.hip is nonempty and one AMD Radeon device is visible
no active training or demo process owns the GPU
GPU use and allocated VRAM are zero at the point-in-time admission check
the accepted supervisor source hash and this contract hash match the launch receipt
stop_conditions: OOM, NaN, non-finite loss, traceback, or nonzero training exit
deadline reserve drops below the time required for demo and local package gates
any destructive cleanup, raw Mantis asset publication, commit, push, PR, or submission
claim_boundary: A passing run proves one fresh 30,000-step ACT optimization job and its checkpoints on the official single AMD Radeon ROCm worker. It does not prove convergence, closed-loop task success, held-out success, G3/G4, robustness, real-robot safety, an AMD performance advantage, or submission.
